why: Home diagnostics fixes need the App's own view types: the mask's area names (AppWindowImage.swift: ScreenshotMask.areaName matches App views such as HomeHostView, InternalPageView, PaneContentView), the screenshot result fields (ScreenshotHandlers.swift), and the blank-pane reason with Home's dock check (PaneController+Diagnostics.swift reads PaneController and HomeDockTab). The pure parts moved to packages: ScreenshotMask.Area and its naming in CmuxNextScreenshots, HomeChiefTabStep in CmuxNextHomeModel.
